description: Reuse one bounded Compose runtime across backend slices and clean it after the final gate.
acceptance_criteria: Every backend node receives the same project-specific Compose project name.
Feature slices reuse services and rebuild only when dependency or image inputs change.
Temporary databases and one-off containers are isolated without touching unrelated Docker workloads.
The final verifier removes runtime resources and obsolete project-labelled revisions while retaining one current image for later client phases.
Client phases and concurrent projects remain isolated.
